messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> HIGH 5xx rate on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). PD incident: INC-122947. Auto-page to oncall (rotation: sara).

PagerDuty: Incident INC-122947 has been created and paged to on-call. Escalation level: L2.

sara: taking this. Acknowledging PD. I'm oncall and will lead.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-122947 acknowledged by sara.

kevin: thx sara. i'm nearby — can help with infra/autoscale.

leo: saw the alert, looks like a burst of 503s from edge LB -> 5xx % spiked to 18% for /v1/generate starting 02:12:08 UTC.

sara: checking console and traces. Firing up dashboards: latency up, error rate concentrated on eu-west-1 inference cluster.

sara: quick checks:
```
# top error from logs (fluentd)
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood --since=10m | grep "503" | head -n 5
```

kevin: running pod health check and restarts count. command:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=redwood --sort-by=.status.restartCount -o wide
```

kevin: several pods (redwood-serve-0, -2) show recent restarts and OOMKilled around the same time as spike. Could be kernel OOMs on the node or a bad model variant.

leo: also seeing a significant increase in request size for a subset of customers — spikes in seq_length causing memory pressure on the runtime.

sara: good signal. immediate mitigation options: 1) shift traffic to regional fallback (eu-central) 2) increase replica count in eu-west and drain bad nodes 3) enable temporary per-route rate limit to shed heavy requests 4) fallback to smaller model variant.

eng-oncall: recommend failover route to dedicated pool for high-priority customers while we stabilize. We have reserved capacity for bursts.

sara: initiating quick action: 1) route low-pri traffic to secondary cluster, 2) scale eu-west inference deployment +3 replicas, 3) enable shorter timeout + circuit-breaker on /v1/generate. Applying now.

kevin: scaling now:
```
kubectl scale deployment redwood-serve -n inference --replicas=12
```

maria (support): tagging this for CS — I'll draft a short status update we can share with affected customers after we stabilize. Which customers are hitting the big payloads?

leo: looking at request logs -> top offenders: acct-102, acct-243, acct-998. I'll add them to the PD incident notes.

sara: also toggling model fallback config to small-quantized-1 for non-SLAs to reduce mem. patching routing rule:
```
POST /api/v1/routing/policy
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"small-quantized-1","priority_only":["acct-998"]}
```

Incident Bot: Runbook link for this alert: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx-eu

kevin: node-level metrics show one node with elevated memory reclaim and kubelet restarts. I'm cordoning it: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-12-45` and draining affected pods.

kevin: drain logs show a few pods failing readiness probes due to slow startup with current quantization kernels. Rolling restart staging to force older kernel path.

sara: PD note update: shifting traffic + scaling + fallback in progress. Visible error rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in last 3 minutes. Will monitor.

maria (support): thanks — prepping message: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting generation in EU. Some customers may experience 5xx. We're routing traffic and scaling capacity; we'll update in 15 minutes." Want me to post to status page?

sara: yes please post and tag affected accounts after we confirm stabilization. Include link to support ticket if they reach out.

leo: confirm: after fallback + scale, error rate down to 2.1%, latency back to baseline for most traffic. There are still sporadic 503s for acct-102.

sara: I'll take ownership for the handoff to the oncall follow-up queue. Creating post-incident ticket for RCAs and follow-ups: INC-122947-FU. Assigning to infra and ml-runtime.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-122947 is now in steady state. Current status: acknowledged -> under investigation -> mitigation applied.

eng-oncall: next steps: 1) collect heap/profile from affected pods 2) reproduce high-seq-length in canary 3) validate quantization kernel compatibility and push kernel fallback patch 4) monitor for 1hr.

sara: leaving a timeline + note:
- 02:12 UTC: PD page fired (INC-122947)
- 02:14 UTC: ack by sara
- 02:16 UTC: scale + route change initiated
- 02:20 UTC: error rate reduced below 5%
- 02:26 UTC: steady state, continuing to monitor

maria (support): posted status update to status.redwood.ai and opened CS notes with accounts flagged. :white_check_mark:

kevin: created follow-up ticket: INFRA-7839 "Investigate eu-west node OOM pattern and quantized runtime mismatch" and assigned to leo + runtime.

leo: will capture flamegraphs and upload to the incident artifact link.

sara: handing off to night oncall at 03:00 UTC — please ping me if it resurfaces. I'll stick on the PD incident until follow-up is assigned.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-122947 acknowledged by sara and marked 'mitigated' at 1712346205 (system timestamp).

sara: closing thread here. Follow-up: INFRA-7839, assign runtime test and postmortem doc. Thanks all for quick responses. :heart:
